breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a more detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent correctly identified the more detailed Strang splitting instructions as the intended method and generated a specification that exclusively implements it, thereby resolving the conflict in alignment with the ground truth.
